notes: Overview: Mid-market SaaS (sales engagement) building outbound SDR chat assistants that can take actions: update CRM, send templated emails, schedule meetings in customer calendars.

Latency requirement: sub-300ms token streaming for agent UX; end-to-end response (first token) target <350ms in US region. Rep emphasized: 'must feel instant for reps'.
Workload profile: high qps during campaign windows (100-400 concurrent SDR sessions), many short-turn conversations with frequent tool-calls (CRM lookups, email send, calendar invites).

Model preferences: open-model variants okay; want recommendations for model+quantization profile that keeps latency low while preserving instruction-following for tool calling. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions.
Security: vendor must support SSO/SAML, audit logs for actions (who triggered emails/CRM updates), KMS integration for customer keys, and ability to host Dedicated inside VPC for PCI/PDPA concerns.
